cast.name: 叶卡捷琳娜·乌尔曼切耶娃 Ekaterina Urmancheeva

introduction: A rare film from Turkmen Soviet Socialist Republic based on the short stories by Washington Irving.As a child, Prince Ahmet was imprisoned in a castle by the power-hungry sultan. When the prince grew up, the sultan, out of fear of losing the throne, ordered the vizier to get rid of the young man by any means. Ahmet must find a way to escape from his prison not only to save his life but also to find the young girl Yasmina, whom he fell in love with, after seeing her only once...Scan from 35mm film found in archives.
